purpose: Challenge issuer-specific quarterly reporting timeliness against the complete relevant terminal mechanism families before freezing an exact formula or reading any protected value.

selected_mechanism.name: quarterly_announcement_timeliness_days
selected_mechanism.economic_hypothesis: A shorter delay from report-period end to the latest point-in-time announcement can indicate faster uncertainty resolution and stronger reporting processes.
selected_mechanism.source_identity: accepted stock-day datetime/symbol/provider identity plus frozen quarterly instrument/report_date/announcement_date only

overlap_challenges.reason: Freshness is the accepted-session age from announcement availability to signal t and changes every session. Timeliness is the fixed calendar-day delay from report_date to announcement_date for the latest effective report and remains constant until another report becomes effective.

Eligibility uses independently forward-filled point-in-time quality values, maximum age, and listing seasoning only as a gate. Campaign032 reads none of those values and ranks eligible names by reporting delay.

The candidate forbids ROE, profit, growth, valuation, balance-sheet, cash-flow, surprise, sign, and magnitude fields; changing every report value while preserving its dates leaves the factor unchanged.
The candidate is neither an event count nor a surprise/content score. It selects exactly the latest effective quarterly report and measures one deterministic report-to-announcement delay.
The candidate loads no minute or daily price, return, range, volume, amount, transaction-price, peer, breadth, dispersion, or volatility field.
Candidate49 uses future same-session minute close/volume/amount geometry. Campaign032 is offline historical disclosure-timing research and cannot write or backfill Candidate49.
Campaign031 relates one-minute stock magnitudes to a leave-one-out market dispersion benchmark. Campaign032 has no price or market benchmark and cannot rescue Campaign031.

counterfactual_independence_tests: Holding the latest effective report_date and announcement_date fixed while changing signal session t changes Campaign020 freshness but leaves Campaign032 timeliness unchanged.
Holding announcement_date and signal t fixed while changing report_date changes Campaign032 timeliness but leaves Campaign020 freshness unchanged.
Holding all report dates fixed while changing every price, return, range, amount, volume, peer state, and report value leaves Campaign032 unchanged.

exact_formula_boundary_to_freeze.formula: negative integer calendar-day difference announcement_date minus report_date for the latest effective quarterly report at signal session t
exact_formula_boundary_to_freeze.availability: announcement_date becomes usable only on the first accepted local session strictly after it; select the latest effective report with effective_session <= t
exact_formula_boundary_to_freeze.same_effective_session_tie_break: stable sort by instrument, effective_session, report_date, announcement_date and keep the last report
exact_formula_boundary_to_freeze.transform: multiply nonnegative calendar-day delay by exact negative one

prohibited_variants: freshness decay, rescale, threshold, or interaction
absolute, reciprocal, logarithmic, exponential, clipped, winsorized, ranked-within-report-type, or fitted delay transform
selected quarter, report type, year, board, industry, or delay threshold
fundamental value, surprise, sign, magnitude, or quality interaction
calendar or source correction after values
Candidate49 historical return, signal, execution, or milestone backfill
